segments.text: I'm Tom. I'm 30 years old. From Sydney.
Sydney? I'm from Mumbai. I'm a hairdresser. What do you do?
I'm a mechanic. I work at the garage downtown.
Really? I'm crazy about cars. I'm a car lover.
Me too. But I don't like sports cars. I'm good at fixing old trucks.
That's cool. I have to go to the salon now.
Catch you later, Tom. Take care, Amy.
